title: The coproduct components of the canonical total tensor comparison
statement: Let e:A→B be a ringed tensor edge [def-weil-pbc-ringed-tensor-square-presentation]. For arbitrary cochain complexes P,Q of A-modules and degrees i,j,n with i+j=n, the inclusion of the (i,j)-summand into T(e*P,e*Q), followed by the degree-n hom of the canonical total comparison, equals μ_e(Pᶦ,Qʲ)⁻¹ followed by e* of the (i,j)-summand inclusion into T(P,Q). The canonical comparison is the total-complex construction in [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback].

proof.text: Unfold the canonical total comparison into its coproduct descent. Apply the defining equation for descent after precomposition with the chosen summand inclusion.

theorem ringedTensorTotalComponent {A B : RingedTensorCorner.{u, w}}
    (e : RingedTensorEdge A B)
    (P Q : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u}
      ((sheafCompose A.topology (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj A.ring)) ℤ)
    (i j n : ℤ) (hij : i + j = n) :
    CochainComplex.ιMapBifunctor
        ((e.pullback.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
        ((e.pullback.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q)
        (@MonoidalCategory.curriedTensor _ _ (monoidalCategory B.ring)) i j n hij ≫
      (e.ordinaryTensor.totalIso A.ring B.ring e.inverseRing e.inverse e.algebraic
        e.ringMap e.pullback e.object_eq e.pushforward e.moduleAdjunction P Q).hom.f n =
    (e.ordinaryTensor.mu (P.X i) (Q.X j)).inv ≫
      e.pullback.map (CochainComplex.ιMapBifunctor P Q
        (@MonoidalCategory.curriedTensor _ _ (monoidalCategory A.ring)) i j n hij)
